# Allwinner PWM source excerpt

`pwm-sunxi-g_dev.c` is retained from `ayueying/linux-5.4`, upstream path
`drivers/pwm/pwm-sunxi-g_dev.c`. The kernel reproduction report records the source
snapshot as commit `ff6b1361` (2022-09-08).

Copyright 2019 AllWinner. The original file header specifies GNU GPL version 2;
retain that header when copying the file.

The same source is embedded in the
[BSP reproduction patch](../../kernels/patches/0001-byte-identical-reproduction.patch).
This standalone copy is evidence for the
[kernel reproduction report](../../../docs/reverse-engineering/stock-kernel-byte-identical-build.md).
